text:
Ben: idea: add an "ensemble-shadow" step to onboarding. before promoting a single candidate we run it alongside the current production model on a sample of shadow traffic and compare divergence and cost-per-token. rationale: catch subtle output regressions that static golden sets miss.
Clara: interesting. how's this different from our SHADOW lane?
Ben: SHADOW today replays traffic offline and aggregates quality metrics over hours. ensemble-shadow runs a lightweight live comparison on a tiny mirrored stream (1-2% traffic) for the first few hours of rollout, but keeps the candidate out of the decision path. we compute per-request similarity, latency delta, and a cheap hallucination score.
Ivy: live mirroring might increase infra load and telemetry volume. what's the budget?
Ben: keep traffic sample very small and do sampling after routing (post-filter). cost estimate: ~0.2 GPU-hours per 10k queries for small models. we can gate ensemble-shadow behind the fast slab passing and a COMPAT deterministic check. only enable for model-major bumps by default.
Raj: metrics to compute? similarity threshold?
Ben: propose: embedding cosine, token-overlap ratio, and a binary hallucination heuristic (LM-perplexity spike or named-entity drop). flag if embedding cosine < 0.88 or token-overlap < 0.6 combined with latency delta > 10ms. aggregate rate > 1% triggers investigation.
Clara: how do we avoid noisy signals from inherently diverse models (e.g., instruction-tuned variants)?
Ivy: label-based bucketing. only compare within intent buckets (classification intents vs. creative). also compute normalized deltas per-bucket. default: be conservative for creative buckets and stricter for utility/classification buckets.
Raj: Console UX: show ensemble_shadow_signal with short-term alerting plus 24h aggregated delta. Rollout policy: allow tenants to opt-in or require ensemble pass for prod.
Ben: ownership: eng-ml builds infra and sampling; product-ops defines bucket mapping and action thresholds.
Clara: failure modes: if ensemble flags a regression after rollout, we need an automated fast rollback path.
Ben: yes: wire ensemble alerts to rollout controller. default action: pause promotion and shift staged traffic back to baseline; send on-call paged only for prod tenants if aggregated regression > 2% over 30m.
Ivy: action items: 1) Ben+Ivy: prototype sampling + lightweight metrics (2 days), 2) Raj: Console flag + rollout mapping (PR), 3) Clara: define bucket mapping and per-bucket sensitivity defaults, 4) eng-sre: quick quota estimate and opt-in controls.
onboard-bot: created ticket ONB-9991 "ensemble-shadow: prototype sampling + rollout hooks" (assignee: Ben).
Raj: +1 to prototype. I'll add opt-out config for dev tenants.
Clara: thanks all. marking this RFC-followup — will collate action items into ONB-9991. :thumbsup:
